verify.note: A proof helper exists and signs only a stored proof object (a separate path, never the master, no transform on the master); the stored proof is width-checked on its own bytes and made without sharp; protect writes it and release deletes it; the Studio renders proofs and never the signed original; the picker list and the Space Loom Studio carry proofs; the picker locks a protected tile. Fails on main and on the LIVE-577 base (no proof helper). The watermark was ruled out by the owner.

append.detail: SHIPPED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1623; owner rulings “Width-capped proof, no watermark” and “Store a small proof file”, which amends HYG-017 for protected images only). Re-tested on the LIVE-577 branch (8df84fe36) from the repo only: the premise held (renditionUrl rewrites public paths only; the Studio signed the ORIGINAL as each protected row’s thumbnail; every pick reader dropped a protected row, and a row flagged Protected whose file had not moved was still placeable with its public master). FOUND in supabase/storage’s source: a transform-signed token carries its transform, but the object route (getSignedObject / verifyObjectSignature) checks only path, scope and expiry, so a transform-signed link of the master opens the master at /object/sign/. So the proof is STORED: lib/library/proof-object.ts writes proofs/<storage_path> in library-private (deterministic path, no column, no migration) from storage’s own resize (the master signed for one minute with width 480, fetched server-side, never handed out; no sharp, check:og-trace), and refuses any bytes whose own header is wider than 480, unreadable, SVG, not an image or over 2 MB. protectLibraryAsset writes it once the master is private and releasing deletes it; both delete doors delete it. proofLibraryAssetUrl signs only that proof object for at most an hour (a missing one is written lazily first), is null for a flagged-but-still-public row, a vector, a fileless row or an unwritable proof, and never signs the master for display. The admin Studio page proofs every protected row; listLoomScopeImages (the personal scope) and listSpaceLoomImages (a Space scope, on the caller session since LIVE-571) keep a private protected row only on includeProtected; loomImages and the Space Loom Studio page pass through withLoomProofs (url swapped, storage key stripped); the picker renders a protected tile locked and the Space Loom Studio badges it. NO WATERMARK (ruled). TESTS: lib/library/proof-url.test.ts (every proof link names proofs/, never the master path; the width check on the bytes), app/(main)/admin/library/actions.test.ts (the proof follows protect and release). docs/LIBRARY.md and the rendition-url.ts header record the HYG-017 amendment. PROBE: passes on this tree; fails on main and on the LIVE-577 base (no proof helper) and on the first transform-signed build (no stored proof); each arm mutation-fired. Also re-pointed LIVE-577’s Studio arm to accept the proof (the page now mints a proof, not a signed original). Until LIVE-578 lands, the Studio drawer’s Open and Download of a protected row give the proof.
